record.paper_title: Separability of Topological Groups: A Survey with Open Problems
record.original_question: Can one construct a precompact abelian topological group G whose quotient groups are all either trivial or non-separable, as in the known zero-dimensional dense subgroup example of T^c, and which additionally has at least one of the following properties: G is connected, G is a Baire space, or G is reflexive?

evidence.quote: There exists an uncountable dense subgroup G of the compact group T^c satisfying dimG=0 such that every countable subgroup of G is closed in G and every uncountable subgroup of G is dense in G. Hence every quotient group of G is either trivial or non-separable.
Does there exist a precompact abelian group G as in Theorem 36 which has one of the following additional properties: (a) G is connected; (b) G is Baire; (c) G is reflexive?

artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature on precompact abelian groups (including work on densities/weights of their quotients, on reflexivity and Baire property in precompact duality, and surveys of separability in topological groups) discusses related constructions but does not provide an example of a precompact abelian group all of whose quotients are trivial or non-separable that is also connected, Baire, or reflexive. No source found that resolves this problem; it appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Densities and Weights of Quotients of Precompact Abelian Groups
status_evidence.snippet: Studies cardinals such that every infinite precompact abelian group admits a quotient of given density character; focuses on weight invariants of quotients.
status_evidence.claim: Does not construct connected/Baire/reflexive precompact abelian groups whose quotients are all trivial or non-separable.

status_evidence.title: The Baire property and precompact duality
status_evidence.snippet: Treats Baire property in precompact dual groups; resolves a question of Chasco, Domínguez and Tkachenko.
status_evidence.claim: Addresses Baire property in precompact duality but does not resolve the specific separability-of-quotients question.

status_evidence.title: Separability of Topological Groups: A Survey with Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing the problem among open questions on separability of topological groups.
